scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street scene with tall buildings, cars, and pedestrians. The scene is set during daytime with clear skies and sunlight casting shadows on the ground. The street is lined with various vehicles including cars and motorcycles. There are also several trees and street furniture such as benches and trash cans along the sidewalk. The buildings have different architectural styles and colors, with some having balconies and others having large windows. The street has white markings indicating pedestrian crossings and bike lanes.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are multi-story structures with varying heights and designs. Some have balconies while others have large windows. The facades are made of different materials such as concrete, brick, and glass. Some buildings appear to be older with worn-out facades, while others look newer and more modern.
scene_analysis.materials: Materials used in construction include concrete, brick, and glass. The street has paved surfaces with asphalt and sidewalks made of concrete. There are also metal railings and gates.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are benches and trash cans placed along the sidewalk. A few bicycles are parked near the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: Trees line the street, providing shade and aesthetic appeal. They are well-maintained and healthy-looking.
scene_analysis.signage: Signs are posted on the buildings and along the street. They provide information about businesses and services available.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking along the sidewalk, going about their daily business. Some are sitting on benches, while others are crossing the street.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be residential, with people living in the surrounding buildings. There are no visible amenities or services.
